sections.shortTitle: Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan Reorganization and Conversion Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (REORGANIZATION AND
CONVERSION) (AMENDMENT)
AGRICULTURAL
DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (REORGANIZATION AND CONVERSION) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXXXV OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Agricultural Development Bank
of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
26-11-2002.----The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Agricultural
Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 7, Ordinance LX of 2002.-----In tine Agricultural Development Bank of
Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance; 2002, in section 7, after
subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(3) Notwithstanding anything contained
in any other law for the time being in force, for the period of three years
from the effective date all sums due to the Company shall, in addition to any
other mode of recovery, be recoverable as arrears of land revenue.".
